subject: Was there a change in how ShinyApps schedules execution?

messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: Was there a change in how ShinyApps schedules execution?
parts:
Hello,
 I have an app at:
https://johnpaul.shinyapps.io/VegShiny/

It mostly works, except when you add a Map Layer using the control at the lower left. 

If used to be that if the application would sometimes gray out after adding the layer, especially if you were on a slow connection.

Now that does happen anymore which is great - but oftentimes the "Layer Legend' panel will not display all of its contents. My code did not change - so presumably shinyApps has how this is executed. Do  you have any insights as to what happened and any advice as to how our apps may work differently - particularity if there are better coding practices I could follow?

Thanks

John Paul
